body: claimed: Antigravity (skull) · 2026-11-16T19:17:40Z · branch mkinney:issue/2158-nesting-kernel · plan: Add deterministic 2D NFP/IFP and bottom-left-fill nesting kernel in crates/geometry/src/nesting/ with kerf/gap inflation, parts-in-holes, multi-sheet reports, and unit tests.

Held work pushed to `mkinney:issue/2158-nesting-kernel` (`edc58501d`); releasing `claimed` because `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` fails twice on pre-existing `upstream/main` breakages (#2244 / PR #2263).

### Implemented on `mkinney:issue/2158-nesting-kernel`
- `crates/geometry/src/nesting/` (`types.rs`, `validate.rs`, `decompose.rs`, `nfp.rs`, `inflate.rs`, `candidates.rs`, `blf.rs`, `mod.rs`) exposed via `crates/geometry/src/lib.rs`
- Pinning tests: `crates/geometry/tests/nesting.rs` (5 tests), `crates/geometry/tests/nesting_modes.rs` (4 tests), `crates/geometry/tests/nesting_refusals.rs` (4 tests)
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/2158-nesting-kernel.md`

### Verified passing on `edc58501d`
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green (0 warnings)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-geometry --test nesting --test nesting_modes --test nesting_refusals --lib`: 46 lib + 13 nesting tests passed (and full `camcraft-geometry` crate suites passed prior to adding the decision doc)
- `cargo test -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-sim` and `cargo test -p camcraft-motion`: passed
- 6 mutation checks (single-slot guard, outer kerf inflation, internal NFP seam tracking, hole obstacle solid fill, hole containment guard, negative margin/gap guard): each failed when disabled and passed when restored

### Blocker in `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` (2 runs)
Because `crates/geometry/src/lib.rs` is in `SHARED`, `quick` falls back to `batch`, which fails in step `[01] debug build (--no-run)` on pre-existing `upstream/main` breakages tracked in #2244 (open PR #2263):
- `crates/app/tests/wire_tool.rs:106` (`CuttingRow` missing `stepdown`/`stepover`, `WorkMaterial` vs `Option<WorkMaterial>`)
- `crates/tools/src/wire.rs:103` (same `CuttingRow` error in `camcraft-tools` lib tests)
- `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs:456` (`step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name`: `fig8.step` missing table row)

Next step once #2244 / PR #2263 merges: merge `upstream/main` into `mkinney:issue/2158-nesting-kernel`, run `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, and open the draft PR.
